Name: Multi-tenant organization model
Description: The platform shall support multiple legal companies, business units, offices, departments, and projects within governed tenant boundaries.
Acceptance_Criteria: A tenant can contain a defined hierarchy while preventing unauthorized cross-tenant access.

Name: Organization hierarchy
Description: Every tenant shall maintain a versioned organization hierarchy with effective dates and ownership.
Acceptance_Criteria: Hierarchy changes preserve history and are visible in audit records.

Name: Role-based access control
Description: The platform shall authorize actions through governed roles and permissions.
Acceptance_Criteria: Every protected action resolves to an explicit permission decision.

Name: Scoped permissions
Description: Permissions shall be scopeable by tenant, company, office, department, project, record type, and owned record where applicable.
Acceptance_Criteria: Users cannot access records outside assigned scopes.

Name: Segregation of duties
Description: Sensitive workflows shall support incompatible-role and dual-approval controls.
Acceptance_Criteria: Configured conflicts block or route the action for independent approval.

Name: User lifecycle governance
Description: User invitation, activation, suspension, termination, and restoration shall follow controlled lifecycle states.
Acceptance_Criteria: Disabled users immediately lose interactive and API access while history is retained.

Name: External user governance
Description: Customers, vendors, subcontractors, consultants, and partners shall be represented as restricted external identities.
Acceptance_Criteria: External access is limited to explicitly shared records and portal capabilities.

Name: Policy management
Description: The platform shall support versioned policies with owners, effective dates, applicability, acknowledgment, and supersession.
Acceptance_Criteria: Only one applicable active version is effective for a given scope and date.

Name: Configuration governance
Description: Enterprise, tenant, company, office, project, and user configuration shall be layered with declared precedence.
Acceptance_Criteria: The effective value is reproducible and shows its source layer.

Name: Approval framework
Description: The platform shall provide configurable approval policies based on object, amount, risk, scope, role, and condition.
Acceptance_Criteria: Approval outcomes are immutable, attributable, timestamped, and auditable.

Name: Delegation of authority
Description: Authorized users shall be able to delegate approval authority for a defined scope and time period.
Acceptance_Criteria: Delegation never exceeds the delegator's authority and preserves attribution.

Name: Audit trail
Description: Material creation, access, change, approval, export, AI action, and administrative events shall be recorded in tamper-evident audit records.
Acceptance_Criteria: Audit events contain actor, action, object, time, source, before/after reference, and correlation identifier.

Name: Data classification
Description: Records and fields shall support governed data classifications and handling requirements.
Acceptance_Criteria: Classification drives access, export, retention, masking, and monitoring controls.

Name: Retention and legal hold
Description: The platform shall apply retention schedules and legal holds without destroying required evidence.
Acceptance_Criteria: Legal hold overrides ordinary deletion and retention expiration.

Name: Record lifecycle
Description: Governed records shall use explicit lifecycle states including draft, review, approved, active, suspended, superseded, archived, and deleted where applicable.
Acceptance_Criteria: Invalid state transitions are blocked and valid transitions are audited.

Name: Change control
Description: Locked specifications, policies, configurations, and master data shall change only through governed change requests.
Acceptance_Criteria: Approved changes include impact analysis, effective date, version increment, and rollback plan.

Name: AI access governance
Description: AI agents shall inherit explicit data and action permissions and shall not bypass user or system authorization.
Acceptance_Criteria: Every AI tool action is authorized, logged, and attributable to an agent and requesting context.

Name: AI writeback approval
Description: AI-generated changes to governed records shall create proposals unless an approved automation policy permits a narrower action.
Acceptance_Criteria: Proposal, reviewer, decision, evidence, and final writeback are traceable.

Name: Administrative console
Description: Authorized administrators shall manage organizations, users, roles, permissions, policies, configuration, approvals, retention, and audit from a governed console.
Acceptance_Criteria: Each administrative surface enforces permission, validation, and audit requirements.

Name: Emergency access
Description: Break-glass access shall require justification, limited duration, elevated logging, notification, and post-event review.
Acceptance_Criteria: Emergency access expires automatically and produces a review case.

Name: Session and device governance
Description: The platform shall support session, device, location, and authentication-risk policies.
Acceptance_Criteria: High-risk sessions can be challenged, restricted, or terminated.

Name: Tenant provisioning
Description: New tenants shall be provisioned from versioned templates with region, units, currency, language, industry packs, and policy defaults.
Acceptance_Criteria: Provisioning creates a reproducible deployment record and validation report.

Name: License and entitlement management
Description: Capabilities shall be controlled through plans, entitlements, feature flags, limits, and effective dates.
Acceptance_Criteria: Unauthorized or expired capabilities are inaccessible without data loss.

Name: Notification governance
Description: Governance events shall notify required owners, approvers, security personnel, or affected users based on policy.
Acceptance_Criteria: Notifications are deduplicated, logged, and escalated where required.

Name: Governance reporting
Description: The platform shall provide governance dashboards and reports for access, approvals, policy status, audit, retention, exceptions, and administrative changes.
Acceptance_Criteria: Reports reconcile to authoritative governance records and respect access scope.
